operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-101. There is established the White House Coal Advisory Council.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 251264; common-crawl capture 2025-10-08T13:47:35Z; Sec. 1-101

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-102. The Council shall be composed of nine members appointed by the President, none of whom shall be an officer or a full-time employee of the United States Government. The President shall designate one of the members to Chair the Council.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 251264; common-crawl capture 2025-10-08T13:47:35Z; Sec. 1-102

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-201. Whenever requested by the President or the Secretary of Labor, the Council shall advise the President and the Secretary of Labor on matters pertaining to labor-management relations in the coal industry, to mine safety, and to productivity in the coal industry.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 251264; common-crawl capture 2025-10-08T13:47:35Z; Sec. 1-201

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-202. The Council shall, from time to time, advise the President or the Secretary of Labor on other issues when the President or the Secretary specifically request the advice of the Council on a particular matter.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 251264; common-crawl capture 2025-10-08T13:47:35Z; Sec. 1-202

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-301. The Secretary of Labor shall, to the extent permitted by law and subject to the availability of funds, provide the Council with such administrative services, funds, facilities, staff, and other support as may be necessary for the effective performance of its functions.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 251264; common-crawl capture 2025-10-08T13:47:35Z; Sec. 1-301

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-302. Members of the Council shall serve without compensation. While engaged in the work of the Council, members may receive travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, as authorized by law (5 U.S.C. 5702 and 5703).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 251264; common-crawl capture 2025-10-08T13:47:35Z; Sec. 1-302

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-401. Notwithstanding the provisions of any other Executive order, the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act, as amended, (5 U.S.C. App. I), except that of reporting annually to the Congress, which are applicable to the Council, shall be performed by the Secretary of Labor in accordance with the guidelines and procedures established by the Administrator of General Services.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 251264; common-crawl capture 2025-10-08T13:47:35Z; Sec. 1-401

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-402. The Council shall terminate one year from the date of this Order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 251264; common-crawl capture 2025-10-08T13:47:35Z; Sec. 1-402
